name: edit_batch
description: Apply multiple edits to one file atomically. dry_run previews diff. Prefer over repeated edit calls. After editing: fix_imports + test_bridge. Use file (workspace-relative) + workspace_dir.

file.description: Path to the file to edit, relative to workspace_dir (e.g. "src/auth.py")

workspace_dir.description: Project root; required when using file (relative)

file_path.description: DEPRECATED alias: absolute path to the file. Allowed only inside workspace_dir when provided.

verbose.description: Return original_content/final_content full text (default: false — diff only)

old_string.description: Text to search for (must uniquely match)

edits.description: Array of edits to apply. Example: [{"old_string": "foo", "new_string": "bar"}]

dry_run.description: Preview changes as unified diff, do not apply

partial.description: Apply successful edits even if some fail. Returns applied_indices, failed_indices, and retry_edits for fixing
